message.reasoning_content:
License income 20-60 alashi is big. Bank 30 alashi only + bids. Rival 2 has 34.6 alashi cash, could outbid me (16.2). So bidding risky — if lose, money returned. Value ~40 alashi extra. I could bid all 16.2 but rival 2 can beat it. Also produce gives goods to sell.

Round 4 action; auction once. If I don't win, bid returned. Opponent 2 with 34M can outbid anything I bid. So bidding is wasteful unless they don't bid. Uncertain. Given EV: chance rivals bid lower. Rival 2 richest, likely bids. Bid moderate, e.g. 10M? If returned, no loss besides... returned at close of action, fine. Bid high like 15M to maximize win chance but 2 can still beat. Maybe bid 16.2 all. But then no action? No, bid then main action still available... "После bid доступно основное действие" — menu offers one combined bid per turn; candidates with bid show goods=0, so bid replaces main action? It says interface offers one aggregate bid per turn. Candidates bid show no goods — so bid replaces action. Hmm "ставка за ход" one per turn. So bid costs producing opportunity.

Better: shuttle/produce for goods to sell in rounds 5-6, plus license contested. Cash ranks matter for payout. I think bid moderate 10M (choice 25): chance to win license ~40 alashi value vs giving up 3 goods (~15 alashi at low prices... sold_counter=3, price 8). Actually shuttle goods sell ~8,7,6 = 21 alashi. License 20-60 plus not included in rank. Expected license gain if win ~40 minus 10 bid = +30. Win prob vs opponents' 34M and 5M cash... rival 2 could bid up to 34M. Probability they don't outbid maybe 30-40%. EV modest.

Alternatively skip license, take shuttle. I'll bid 10M.
